result.alias_collapse: Both phases reduce exact repeated-row label conflict (median range 10.0 -> 0.0) but repeated-row coverage collapses as continuous columns are added (28,383 rows / 902 groups at current_row -> 543 / 93 at +sys_demand), so alias collapse is secondary evidence only; the held-out routing gate is decisive.
result.gate: BOTH PHASES FAILED — every tested deployable block (6 Phase-1 pp_/h_ + 5 Phase-2 sys_) beats the deployed actor floor 0/3 tasks for BOTH ridge+interactions and kNN; centered within-decision r2 <= 0 (Phase-2 ridge drifts more negative as blocks accumulate: -0.02 -> -0.18 -> -0.22 -> -0.21 -> -0.25; knn ~ -0.05); adding blocks raises or holds held-out routing regret at/above the random floor.
result.verdict: Neither deployable class — per-producer/product (Phase 1) nor system-wide interaction context (Phase 2) — makes the EXP-0037 marginal-value teacher label a learnable within-decision routing target. The teacher's producer preference is not a function of any tested decision-time observation; it lives in the 8-cycle rollout. Retiring the marginal-value target as an actor objective is LICENSED. blend_0.5 remains the orderer floor.
result.actor_training_note: No enriched actor was trained (gate never passed). A learned orderer must emulate the rollout (a compute lever) or optimise a different, obs-measurable objective.

question: Do any deployable metrics — per-producer/product (Phase 1) or system-wide interaction context (Phase 2) — make the EXP-0037 marginal-value teacher label learnable for within-decision routing?
driver: tokenomics.eval.value_router_errors --feature-set producer_product_v1 | producer_product_system_v1 (dump) + tokenomics.eval.observation_ladder (audit); blocks built in tokenomics.eval.producer_product_features (pp_* Phase 1, sys_* Phase 2)

P0_current_row: feat_5 input inventory plus inbound binding ratio

last-5-cycle completion and rejection rates for target product
last-5-cycle completion latency for target product
output inventory delta for target product

other orderer queued quantity for target product
